adjudication.rationale: In `app/assets/javascripts/admin/components/embeddable-host.js.es6`, the `delete()` action calls `this.get('host').destroyRecord().then(...)` but does not attach a `.catch(...)` (unlike `save()`, which uses `.catch(popupAjaxError)`). If the DELETE request fails, there is no local error handling/feedback path in this code, so the failure won’t trigger `deleteHost` and the user won’t see an error popup from this component.
